name: Lilith Ophio
source: A Pharmaceutical Scientist that has a love-hate relationship with her job. Ambitious and no-nonsense she only tolerates and cares for her younger twin sister Laura and often dotes on her. She is blunt, honest, and not afraid to do whatever she can to ensure that her sister survives whatever games get thrown at her.
